implementation_requirements: Choose any number of distinct enemy Order units with combined current Might at most 5; zero legal.
Recheck controller, current domains, untargetability and identities at resolution.
If combined Might no longer fits, controller selects an inclusion-maximal legal subset of only original eligible targets. Zero-Might targets cannot be silently dropped.
Use an explicit subset action; do not enumerate all combinations or impose a cardinality cap.
